item.title: Easel 1.0.1
item.description:
Easel opens again after you install it.
### Fixed - **Opening Easel:** 1.0.0 quit as soon as it opened on a Mac where it hadn’t been built. It now finds its menus, help and built-in models inside the app.

item.title: Easel 1.0.0
item.description:
The first copy of Easel to share as a file. It now keeps itself up to date.
### New - **Easel > Check for Updates…** looks for a new version on Easel’s GitHub releases. Easel also checks once a day by itself. - **Settings > Updates:** your version, when Easel last checked, and whether updates download and install by themselves when you quit. Include beta versions if you want previews of the next release. - **What’s New in Easel** opens once after each update with what changed, and any time from Help > What’s New in Easel.
